messages:
sam: quick sync: Large customer asks for tiered carryover (they want different % caps per contract) + audit trail surfaced in Console + API to programmatically consume.
anya: we need to be explicit about billing semantics. carryover is a non-refundable soft credit applied before paid usage. has to show up on invoice and exports.
billing-bot: FYI: any soft credit affecting invoice line-items must include a carryover_credit_id for reconciliation and anti-fraud checks.
eng-lead: implementation sketch: introduce CarryoverPolicy object on pool config, with tiers, ttl, and enforcement on accounting pipeline. telemetry event: CARRYOVER_GRANT with fields (tenant_id, pool_id, amount_tokens, tier, credit_id, expires_at).
oncall: ops concerns: audit trail must be immutable and exported to our ELK for 90 days; add an alert if carryover grants spike > 3x baseline in 1h (could be abuse or bug).
anya: legal/regulatory check: for EU customers we may need different wording (VAT, refunds). propose: EU-regulated tenants default to carryover_disabled until finance signoff.
sam: UX: show a per-pool carryover badge and detailed modal with history. allow CSV export and API endpoint: GET /v1/pools/:id/carryover_history.

```http
GET /v1/pools/abcd-1234/carryover_history
Response: [{"credit_id":"CO-0001","granted_at":"2026-02-01T00:00:00Z","amount_tokens":12000,"tier":"silver","expires_at":"2026-03-03T00:00:00Z"}]
```

eng-lead: implementation notes: billing-side must treat carryover as zero-cost token bucket separate from reserved quota. Consumption order: carryover -> prepaid reserved -> on-demand. That preserves commitments.
anya: product decision point: tier defaults? I propose default=bronze (max_pct=5) for new trials, upgrade to silver/gold via contract. will this satisfy sales?
sam: yes, sales OK with defaults. but need migration path for existing customers who already have ad-hoc carryover agreements.
oncall: add circuit-breaker: if a tenant uses >50% carryover in a rolling day, emit warning and throttle further carryover application pending manual review.
eng-lead: telemetry events to emit: CARRYOVER_GRANT, CARRYOVER_CONSUMED, CARRYOVER_EXPIRED, CARRYOVER_REVOKED. include correlation id for billing reconciliation.
anya: launch criteria draft: 1) Console UI for pool + CSV/API export; 2) Billing export includes carryover_credit_id; 3) Audit events emitted to ELK for 90d retention; 4) Default tier + opt-in/upgrades defined; 5) EU regulatory signoff or disabled by default.
sam: roadmap: spike (1 week) to implement audit events + one-way billing flag; then 2-week sprint to build Console surface and API endpoints; canary with 1 lighthouse customer on week 6.
eng-lead: staffing: 2 backend, 1 frontend, 1 billing eng, 1 ops for canary.
oncall: can we add throttles to prevent carryover stacking across pools? edge-case: same tenant across multiple pools trying to exploit carryover. propose global tenant-level cap (max_global_carryover_pct).

```yaml
carryover_policy:
  default_tier: bronze
  tiers:
    - name: bronze
      max_pct: 5
    - name: silver
      max_pct: 10
    - name: gold
      max_pct: 20
  ttl_days: 30
  global_tenant_cap_pct: 25
```

anya: good. billing export note: include carryover_credit_id on invoice lines and in the usage CSV so customers can reconcile. also add a customer-visible note: "Carryover credits are non-refundable and expire after X days."
sam: decision: default_enabled=false for regulated regions, default_tier=bronze for others, migration path required for existing ad-hoc credits.
product-bot: Created tickets: #PL-4020 (spike: carryover audit events), #BILL-2201 (billing export + credit id), #FE-789 (console carryover modal), #OPS-1400 (alerts + ELK retention).
anya: action items: - @eng-lead: create spike PR and wire up CARRYOVER_GRANT event. - @billing-bot: prepare CSV schema change. - @oncall: draft alert thresholds. - @sam: update roadmap doc and talk to sales about migration messaging.
sam: thanks, will sync with sales after spike results.
